verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Delta Sharing/OpenSharing as a dedicated platform for sharing live data and AI assets with users outside the organization regardless of whether they use Databricks, explicitly avoiding data copies or export pipelines, plus a Marketplace/Open Marketplace for publishing and discovering shared listings across accounts. This directly matches the story of sharing live datasets cross-account/cross-org without copying data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Delta Sharing in practice and more detail on live-query semantics vs. snapshotting.
